title: How do you Identify a Good Manager?
title_primary: How do you Identify a Good Manager?
authors: Ben Weidmann, Joseph Vecci, Farah Said, Sonia Bhalotra, Achyut Adharvyu 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-15 · 来源：CEPR 页面
abstract: This paper introduces and validates a novel approach to measuring management skills. In a large pre-registered lab experiment we causally identify managerial contributions by randomly assigning managers to multiple teams and controlling for differences in individual skill. We find that manager contributions matter greatly for team success, and that people who want to be in charge perform worse than randomly assigned managers. Managerial performance is strongly predicted by economic decision-making skill, but not by demographic characteristics. LinkedIn data show that participants who succeed in the lab are substantially more likely to receive real-world promotions. We also measure the skills of store managers in a large retail firm and find that they predict store sales and other correlates of productivity, which aligns with our experimental results. A one standard deviation increase in manager quality increases annual per-store sales by $4.1 million USD (25% increase). Selecting managers on skills rather than demographic characteristics or the desire to lead could substantially improve organizational performance.

title: DP20826 Tariffs and Technological Hegemony
title_zh: 关税与技术霸权
title_primary: 关税与技术霸权
title_secondary: DP20826 Tariffs and Technological Hegemony
authors: Luca Fornaro, Martin Wolf
official: 官方在线 2025-11-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We provide a theory connecting trade policies to innovation and technological hegemony, based on the notion that high-tech clusters generate technological rents for the countries hosting them. We show that tariffs on high-tech imports may be used to steal technological rents from the rest of the world, by redirecting innovation activities from foreign to domestic firms. This strategy may lead to welfare gains, which however come at the expense of even larger welfare losses in the rest of the world. Tariffs may backfire even for the country imposing them if they are not well designed, or if the rest of the world retaliates.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种将贸易政策与创新及技术霸权相联系的理论，其基础在于高技术集群为东道国带来技术租金。我们表明，对高技术进口品征收关税可被用于从世界其他地区窃取技术租金，其途径是将创新活动从外国企业转向本国企业。这一策略可能带来福利收益，然而其代价是世界其他地区更大的福利损失。若关税设计不当，或世界其他地区采取报复措施，关税甚至可能对征收国自身产生反噬效应。

title: Legacy of Soviet-aided industrialization in China: A quasi-experiment
title_zh: 苏联援华工业化的遗产：一项准实验研究
title_primary: 苏联援华工业化的遗产：一项准实验研究
title_secondary: Legacy of Soviet-aided industrialization in China: A quasi-experiment
authors: Clair Yang
official: 官方在线 2026-09-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A large portion of the developing world has pursued big-push industrialization to promote growth over the past century. This paper utilizes a quasi-experimental design to investigate the long-term impact of such programs. From 1950 to 1959, the Soviet Union sent thousands of experts, engineers, and machinery to China to aid with the first Five-Year Plan of national development and to help establish a network of state-owned industrial plants across China. This massive program was brought to an abrupt standstill following the Sino-Soviet split in the early 1960s. This paper takes the unforeseen termination of the Soviet projects as an exogenous shock and investigates its impact on local economic development in the long run. Counties with more Soviet projects completed by the 1960s are shown to have larger state sectors today and, surprisingly, also enjoy better developmental outcomes overall and in the private sector in particular. Five mechanisms are examined as potential causes. I find no evidence of innovation spillover or differential infrastructure, but strong support for human capital externality and agglomeration through production networks. Resource allocation also continues to favor these localities: even private businesses in counties with more Soviet projects enjoy better access to the financial market.
abstract_zh: 过去一个世纪里，发展中世界的很大一部分地区推行了大推进工业化以促进增长。本文利用准实验设计来考察此类项目的长期影响。1950年至1959年间，苏联派遣了数千名专家、工程师并输送机械设备至中国，协助实施第一个五年国家发展计划，并帮助在中国各地建立国有工业工厂网络。然而，这一大规模项目在20世纪60年代初因中苏分裂而骤然中断。本文将苏联项目的意外终止视为外生冲击，考察其对地方经济的长期影响。研究发现，截至20世纪60年代完成更多苏联项目的县，如今国有部门规模更大，且令人意外的是，这些地区整体发展成果更佳，尤其是私营部门表现更为突出。本文考察了五种可能的机制，未发现创新溢出或基础设施差异的证据，但人力资本外部性和通过生产网络形成的集聚效应得到了有力支持。资源配置也持续偏向这些地区：即便在苏联项目较多的县，私营企业也能获得更好的金融市场准入机会。

title: Opening Hours and Consumer Behavior: Evidence from GPS Data and Deregulation
title_zh: 营业时间与消费者行为：来自GPS数据和放松管制的证据
title_primary: 营业时间与消费者行为：来自GPS数据和放松管制的证据
title_secondary: Opening Hours and Consumer Behavior: Evidence from GPS Data and Deregulation
authors: Javier Donna, Marit Hinnosaar, Toomas Hinnosaar, André Trindade
official: 官方在线 2025-07-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: On August 1, 2019, North Dakota repealed its Sunday closing law, which had required most non-grocery stores to close between midnight and noon on Sundays. Using this policy change and detailed GPS data on consumer movement, we study the impact of store opening hours on shopping behavior and welfare. We compare store visits before and after the repeal in North Dakota and neighboring states, using difference-in-differences and event study designs. The repeal led to a large increase in Sunday morning store visits in North Dakota. This change reflects a rise in overall shopping frequency, along with intertemporal substitution (mainly from Sunday afternoon), substitution across store types (from grocery stores), and cross-border shopping to Minnesota. We find that the welfare loss from the Sunday sales restriction for Walmart stores is equivalent to increasing the travel distance to Walmart by about 1.7 miles for each consumer.
abstract_zh: 2019年8月1日，北达科他州废除了其周日歇业法，该法曾要求大多数非杂货店在周日午夜至中午期间关闭。利用这一政策变化及消费者移动的详细GPS数据，我们研究了商店营业时间对购物行为及福利的影响。我们通过双重差分法和事件研究设计，比较了北达科他州及邻近州在废除前后商店访问量的变化。废除该法导致北达科他州周日上午商店访问量大幅增加。这一变化反映了整体购物频率的上升，以及跨期替代（主要来自周日下午）、跨商店类型替代（来自杂货店）和跨境购物至明尼苏达州的现象。我们发现，周日销售限制对沃尔玛商店造成的福利损失，相当于每位消费者前往沃尔玛的出行距离增加了约1.7英里。

title: Do information and communication technologies empower female workers? Evidence from Vietnam
title_zh: 信息和通信技术是否赋能女性劳动者？来自越南的证据
title_primary: 信息和通信技术是否赋能女性劳动者？来自越南的证据
title_secondary: Do information and communication technologies empower female workers? Evidence from Vietnam
authors: Heiwai Tang, Wang Yao, Victoria Wenxin Xie, Natalie Chun
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine the impact of information and communication technology (ICT) adoption on female employment outcomes in Vietnam, using data at both the firm and household levels. Our identification strategy leverages geographic variation in the engineering costs of connecting to Vietnam’s ICT backbone, along with the temporal shock of the 2007 major network capacity expansion. We find that increased ICT adoption raises firms’ female labor share and reduces gender gaps in monthly work days, formal employment, and time spent on housework. We also document a plausible mechanism: ICT adoption shifts labor demand away from routine and manual tasks toward social, customer-facing, and service-oriented tasks—areas in which women are more likely to hold a comparative advantage.
abstract_zh: 我们利用丰富的企业和个人层面数据，研究了信息与通信技术（ICT）采纳对越南女性就业结果的影响。我们的识别策略利用了由地理连接条件和2007年全国网络升级所驱动的ICT接入的外生变化。研究发现，ICT采纳提高了企业内女性就业份额，主要通过正规部门内的企业内部重新配置实现。我们进一步提供了与任务重新配置渠道相一致的证据：ICT与劳动力需求从常规性和体力任务向社交、客户导向及服务型活动的转变相关联，而女性在这些领域更可能具有比较优势。

title: Beyond Counting Treaties: Using Network Analysis to Reveal the Structural Changes in the Spaghetti Bowl
title_zh: 超越计数条约：运用网络分析揭示意大利面碗的结构变化
title_primary: 超越计数条约：运用网络分析揭示意大利面碗的结构变化
title_secondary: Beyond Counting Treaties: Using Network Analysis to Reveal the Structural Changes in the Spaghetti Bowl
authors: Justine Miller, Samuel Standaert
official: 官方在线 2026-08-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Since the 1990s, the proliferation of Regional Integration Agreements (RIAs) has created a complex trading environment where countries belong to multiple agreements simultaneously. The Spaghetti Bowl (SB)—a tangled web of overlapping agreements—has primarily been viewed as a visual metaphor. However, this overlooks its multidimensional nature and the interplay between membership and content overlap, lacking an empirical account. This paper presents a more formal, empirically grounded definition of the SB, using a network‐based framework to measure it, capturing its multidimensionality and tracing its regional and temporal evolution with historical RIA data. In contrast to the linear SB growth implied by the traditional count of agreements, our network measures indicate that the SB was essentially nonexistent before 1970. This is followed by three distinct waves of SB growth. Our analysis shows the SB rapidly expanded in the 1970s, became regional in the 1990s and early 2000s, and has become increasingly global since 2010 due to Interregional RIAs. Furthermore, we argue that global entanglement levels are becoming more widespread, even as individual RIAs contribute less to the phenomenon. This recent increase in SB prevalence is underestimated by the method of counting the active RIAs.
abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代以来，区域一体化协定（RIAs）的激增创造了一个复杂的贸易环境，各国同时属于多个协定。意大利面碗（SB）——一个由重叠协定交织而成的复杂网络——主要被视为一种视觉隐喻。然而，这忽视了其多维性质以及成员资格与内容重叠之间的相互作用，缺乏实证说明。本文提出了一个更为正式、基于实证的SB定义，采用基于网络的框架对其进行测量，捕捉其多维性，并利用历史RIA数据追踪其区域和时间演变。与传统的协定数量所暗示的SB线性增长相反，我们的网络测量表明，SB在1970年之前基本上不存在。此后出现了三波明显的SB增长。我们的分析显示，SB在20世纪70年代迅速扩展，在20世纪90年代和21世纪初变得区域化，并且自2010年以来由于跨区域RIAs而日益全球化。此外，我们认为，全球纠缠水平正变得越来越普遍，即使单个RIAs对这一现象的贡献减少。近期SB普遍性的上升被统计活跃RIAs的方法所低估。

title: Building Blocks of Prosperity: The Job Impacts of Federal Block Grants for Developing Low-Income Communities
title_zh: 繁荣的基石：联邦整笔拨款对低收入社区发展的就业影响
title_primary: 繁荣的基石：联邦整笔拨款对低收入社区发展的就业影响
title_secondary: Building Blocks of Prosperity: The Job Impacts of Federal Block Grants for Developing Low-Income Communities
authors: Zuo, George W.
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Economic Policy · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: I study the job impacts of the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG), a federal program which provides local governments with block grants to flexibly invest in low-income neighborhoods. I leverage a one-time shock to the formula allocation process which permanently re-shuffled grant generosity, simultaneously creating large funding shocks in both directions. While job counts increased in positively shocked localities relative to unaffected localities, job counts remained steady in negatively shocked localities. I document asymmetric effects on local public finance mechanisms to support these findings. I also leverage itemized CDBG expenditure data to uncover correlates of high-impact place-based investments.
abstract_zh: 我研究了社区发展整笔拨款（CDBG）的就业影响，这是一项联邦计划，向地方政府提供整笔拨款，以灵活投资于低收入社区。我利用公式分配过程中的一次性冲击，该冲击永久性地重新调整了拨款慷慨程度，同时造成了两个方向上的大规模资金冲击。尽管受到正向冲击的地方相对于未受影响的地方就业人数有所增加，但受到负向冲击的地方就业人数保持稳定。我记录了地方公共财政机制中的不对称效应，以支持这些发现。我还利用逐项列出的CDBG支出数据，揭示了高影响地点型投资的相关因素。

title: Should Charitable and Political Donations Benefit from Similar Tax Treatments? Evidence from a Survey Experiment
title_zh: 慈善捐赠与政治捐赠是否应享有相似的税收待遇？来自调查实验的证据
title_primary: 慈善捐赠与政治捐赠是否应享有相似的税收待遇？来自调查实验的证据
title_secondary: Should Charitable and Political Donations Benefit from Similar Tax Treatments? Evidence from a Survey Experiment
authors: Julia Cage, Malka Guillot, Yuchen Huang
official: 官方在线 2026-02-08 · 来源：CEPR 页面
abstract: we investigate the relative efficiency of different tax schemes in fostering political and charitable donations. We document that repealing the existing non-refundable income-tax credit decreases charitable donations but not political donations, pointing toward greater fiscal incentives behind charitable giving. We next show that, conditional on giving, matching – where the government matches individual donations at a fixed rate –increases both political and charitable giving, but that it decreases the probability of giving to charities at the extensive margin. Finally, using a Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and generic machine learning, we document important dimensions of heterogeneity, and discuss the policy implications of our findings.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了不同税收方案在促进政治捐赠和慈善捐赠方面的相对效率。研究显示，取消现有的不可退还所得税抵免会减少慈善捐赠，但对政治捐赠无显著影响，这表明财政激励对慈善捐赠的推动作用更为显著。进一步地，我们发现在给予捐赠的前提下，匹配机制——即政府按固定比例匹配个人捐赠——能同时增加政治和慈善捐赠，但在广泛边际上降低了向慈善机构捐赠的概率。最后，通过主成分分析（PCA）和通用机器学习方法，我们揭示了异质性的重要维度，并探讨了研究结果的政策含义。

title: Quantitative Trade with Ships
title_zh: 船舶定量贸易
title_primary: 船舶定量贸易
title_secondary: Quantitative Trade with Ships
authors: Sonali Chowdhry, Inga Heiland, Hendrik Mahlkow
official: 官方在线 2026-03-04 · 来源：CEPR 页面
abstract: This paper highlights an underexplored margin of heterogeneity that shapes resilience to disruptions in global shipping - the differential reliance of countries and sectors on specific categories of vessels. We combine US bills of lading records with ship registry and AIS-based port call data to document new stylized facts on vessel deployment, including switching patterns across ships, country specialization in shipbuilding, and the composition of fleets serving different country pairs. Exploiting the 2016 Panama Canal expansion as a quasi-natural experiment, we further provide the first direct estimate for the elasticity of substitution between vessels across size classes. Building on the empirical evidence, we then introduce endogenous vessel choice into a quantitative general equilibrium trade model that features multiple transport modes and a global market for shipping services. The model allows us to quantify the trade and welfare effects of two recent policy proposals that target specific types, namely, fees for Chinese-built vessels entering US ports and the inclusion of the maritime transport sector in the EU Emission Trading System.
abstract_zh: 本文揭示了一个尚未充分探索的异质性维度——各国及各部门对不同类别船舶的差异化依赖——如何影响其对全球航运中断的韧性。我们结合美国提单记录、船舶登记数据以及基于AIS的港口停靠数据，系统梳理了船舶部署的新典型事实，包括船舶间的切换模式、各国在造船领域的专业化分工，以及服务于不同国家配对航线的船队构成。以2016年巴拿马运河扩建为准自然实验，我们首次直接估算了不同吨位级别船舶之间的替代弹性。基于实证证据，我们进一步将内生船舶选择引入一个包含多种运输方式及全球航运服务市场的量化一般均衡贸易模型。该模型使我们能够量化两项近期针对特定类型船舶的政策提案的贸易与福利效应：一是针对中国建造船舶进入美国港口征收的费用，二是将海运部门纳入欧盟排放交易体系。

title: Trading Off Openness: Economic Information and Immigration Policy Preferences
title_zh: 权衡开放：经济信息与移民政策偏好
title_primary: 权衡开放：经济信息与移民政策偏好
title_secondary: Trading Off Openness: Economic Information and Immigration Policy Preferences
authors: Cristina Cattaneo, Daniela Grieco, Nicola Lacetera, Mario Macis
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We conducted a survey experiment with over 8,000 participants in Germany, Hungary, and Italy to examine how information about the economic impact of immigration affects the support for more open immigration policies. Respondents who received projections showing higher future incomes under more open immigration policies reported greater support for these policies. The treatment also partly changed how prior attitudes affected policy preferences. Structural estimates suggest that majority support for immigration above current levels would require annual per-capita income gains of about 1.2% in Italy and 1.7% in Germany, and still larger or unattainable gains in Hungary. These increases are large relative to recent historical growth rates, suggesting that economic benefits alone are unlikely to generate vast support for more open immigration policies.
abstract_zh: 我们在德国、匈牙利和意大利开展了一项涵盖8000多名参与者的调查实验，旨在探究关于移民经济影响的信息如何影响公众对更开放移民政策的支持度。当受访者获知更开放的移民政策将带来更高未来收入的预测时，他们对这些政策的支持度显著提升。这一干预措施还部分改变了既有态度对政策偏好的影响方式。结构模型估计显示，要使多数民众支持超过当前水平的移民规模，意大利和德国分别需要实现约1.2%和1.7%的人均年收入增长，而匈牙利则需要更高甚至难以企及的增幅。这些增长幅度相较于近年历史增长率而言相当可观，表明仅凭经济收益难以催生对更开放移民政策的广泛支持。

title: Common Ownership and Hedge Fund Activism: An Unholy Alliance?
title_zh: 共同所有权与对冲基金激进主义：不洁的联盟？
title_primary: 共同所有权与对冲基金激进主义：不洁的联盟？
title_secondary: Common Ownership and Hedge Fund Activism: An Unholy Alliance?
authors: Zohar Goshen, Doron Levit
official: 官方在线 2024-09-06 · 来源：CEPR 页面
abstract: This paper proposes a novel mechanism linking common ownership to anticompetitive outcomes. Common owners promote shareholder-friendly governance policies in their portfolio firms, empowering interventions by activist hedge funds that discourage managers from investing. The cumulative impact of hedge fund activism contributes to anticompetitive outcomes, without collusion between managers. Effectively, and possibly unintentionally, common owners exert monopsonistic power over labor by reducing aggregate investment. Subsequently, the artificially depressed wages result in transfer of wealth to shareholders. While hedge fund activism generally improves social welfare in a competitive equilibrium, it may reduce social welfare under common ownership. The symbiotic relationship between common owners and activist hedge funds can be detrimental to society. The paper establishes a new connection between the rise of institutional ownership, adoption of shareholder-friendly policies, increased hedge fund activism, reduced investment and labor share, and heightened capital market returns.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的机制，将共同所有权与反竞争结果联系起来。共同所有者在投资组合公司中推行有利于股东的公司治理政策，从而增强激进对冲基金的干预能力，抑制管理层的投资行为。对冲基金激进主义的累积效应导致了反竞争结果，而无需管理层之间的合谋。实际上，共同所有者可能无意中通过减少总投资来对劳动力施加垄断买方权力。随后，人为压低的工资导致财富向股东转移。尽管在竞争均衡中，对冲基金激进主义通常能改善社会福利，但在共同所有权下，它可能降低社会福利。共同所有者与激进对冲基金之间的共生关系可能对社会有害。本文建立了机构所有权上升、股东友好政策采纳、对冲基金激进主义增加、投资与劳动份额下降以及资本市场回报率提高之间的新联系。

title: Long-term morality effects of behavioral interventions in networks
title_zh: 网络中行为干预的长期道德效应
title_primary: 网络中行为干预的长期道德效应
title_secondary: Long-term morality effects of behavioral interventions in networks
authors: Erik Gråd, Theodoros Rapanos, Ranjula Bali Swain, Shyam Ranganathan
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we develop a dynamic model of moral preferences in repeated public goods games on networks. We incorporate informational nudges and derive conditions for convergence of behavior and optimal targeting of policies. Importantly, the long-term impact of moral nudges on preferences and behavior depends on how preferences evolve. When preferences include a component of persistent intrinsic morality, the effect of a moral nudge dissipates over time. Conversely, if social preferences continuously evolve, influenced by recent periods and present experiences, the potential for long-lasting effects of behavioral interventions becomes more promising. We also discuss heterogeneous adaptation, which improves the model’s predictive power for laboratory public-goods experiments. With the framework constructed in this paper, outcomes in experimental, field and natural experiments can be evaluated to further understand what drives individual decision making.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个网络重复公共品博弈中的道德偏好动态模型。我们引入信息助推，推导出行为收敛与政策最优靶向的条件。重要的是，道德助推对偏好与行为的长期影响取决于偏好的演化方式。当偏好包含持久内在道德成分时，道德助推的效果会随时间消散。相反，若社会偏好持续演化，受近期阶段与当前经验影响，行为干预产生持久效应的可能性将更为乐观。我们还讨论了异质性适应问题，这提升了模型对实验室公共品实验的预测能力。借助本文构建的分析框架，可评估实验、实地实验与自然实验的结果，从而进一步理解个体决策的驱动因素。

title: Puzzles and dynamics in resource allocation: An introduction
title_zh: 资源分配中的谜题与动态：导论
title_primary: 资源分配中的谜题与动态：导论
title_secondary: Puzzles and dynamics in resource allocation: An introduction
authors: Changxia Ke, Lucas Rentschler, Shane D. Sanders
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The papers collected in this special issue address two enduring difficulties in the economics of resource allocation. The first concerns the cost of allocation itself: contestants routinely expend resources in pursuit of a prize far in excess of what equilibrium reasoning would suggest, and conflict over resources destroys a portion of the value it reallocates. The second concerns the consequences of allocation: control over a valuable resource frequently fails to translate into improved welfare for the party that secures it. The nine contributions approach these problems from theoretical, experimental, and empirical directions, and several of them bear on the connection between how resources are contested and what follows once control is established. This introduction situates the papers within the contest-theoretic and resource-economics literatures from which they draw, identifies the questions they leave open, and sketches a theoretical bridge between issues of puzzle and dynamics in the resource allocation literature.

abstract: This paper shows that relative-wage compression is conducive to higher employer-initiated job turnover, and argues that wage-setting institutions and job security provisions differ across countries in ways that are both consistent with rough uniformity of job turnover statistics and readily explained by intuitive theoretical considerations. When viewed as a component of the mix of institutional differences in Europe and North America, European dismissal restrictions are essential to a proper interpretation of both similar patterns in job turnover, and marked differences in unemployment flows.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，相对工资压缩有利于提高雇主发起的岗位流动率，并论证各国工资设定制度与工作保障条款的差异，既与岗位流动统计数据的粗略一致性相符，也可通过直观的理论考量得到合理解释。当将欧洲与北美的制度差异组合视为整体时，欧洲的解雇限制对于正确解读岗位流动的相似模式以及失业流动的显著差异至关重要。

title: Consumable Data via Quantum Communication
title_zh: 通过量子通信实现的可消费数据
title_primary: 通过量子通信实现的可消费数据
title_secondary: Consumable Data via Quantum Communication
authors: D. Gilboa, Siddhartha Jain, Jarrod R. McClean
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 2026-07-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Classical data can be copied and re-used for computation, with adverse consequences economically and in terms of data privacy. Motivated by this, we formulate problems in one-way communication complexity where Alice holds some data x and Bob holds m inputs 𝑦 1 , … , 𝑦 𝑚 . They want to compute m instances of a bipartite relation 𝑅 ( · , · ) on every pair ( 𝑥 , 𝑦 1 ) , … , ( 𝑥 , 𝑦 𝑚 ) . We call this the asymmetric direct sum question for one-way communication. We give examples where the quantum communication complexity of such problems scales polynomially with m, while the classical communication complexity depends at most logarithmically on m. Thus, for such problems, data behaves like a consumable resource that is effectively destroyed upon use when the owner stores and transmits it as quantum states, but not when transmitted classically. We show an application to a strategic data-selling game, and discuss other potential economic implications.
abstract_zh: 经典数据可以被复制并重新用于计算，这在经济层面和数据隐私方面带来了不利后果。基于此，我们构建了单向通信复杂度中的问题，其中Alice持有数据x，Bob持有m个输入y₁,…,yₘ。他们希望计算一个二分关系R(·,·)在每一对(x,y₁),…,(x,yₘ)上的m个实例。我们称之为单向通信的非对称直接求和问题。我们给出了示例，其中此类问题的量子通信复杂度随m呈多项式增长，而经典通信复杂度对m的依赖至多为对数级别。因此，对于此类问题，当数据所有者以量子态存储和传输数据时，数据表现得像一种消耗性资源，在使用时被有效销毁；而经典传输则不会如此。我们展示了这一发现在一个战略性数据销售游戏中的应用，并讨论了其他潜在的经济影响。

title: The Lasting Effects of Working while in School: A Long-Term Follow-Up
title_zh: 在校期间兼职的持久影响：一项长期追踪研究
title_primary: 在校期间兼职的持久影响：一项长期追踪研究
title_secondary: The Lasting Effects of Working while in School: A Long-Term Follow-Up
authors: Ferrando, Mery, Katzkowicz, Noemí, Le Barbanchon, Thomas, Ubfal, Diego
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper provides the first experimental evidence on the long-term effects of work-study programs, leveraging a randomized lottery design from a national program in Uruguay. Participation leads to a persistent 11 percent increase in formal labor earnings seven years after the program, driven by a 4 percent increase in the monthly probability of being employed and a 6 percent increase in monthly wages. Effects are significantly larger for men, while remaining positive for women. The program is highly cost-effective, outperforming most job training programs and reaching levels comparable to early childhood investments.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于工读项目长期效果的首个实验证据，利用乌拉圭一项全国性项目的随机抽签设计。参与该项目七年后，正规劳动收入持续增长11%，其驱动因素为月就业概率提高4%和月工资增长6%。男性参与者的效果显著更大，而女性参与者的效果仍为正向。该项目具有极高的成本效益，优于大多数职业培训项目，其效果水平可与早期儿童投资相媲美。

title: Banking on a Corporate Rebrand
title_zh: 押注企业品牌重塑
title_primary: 押注企业品牌重塑
title_secondary: Banking on a Corporate Rebrand
authors: Kilian Rieder, Matthew Jaremski, Kris Mitchener
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Firms often rebrand to counter negative shocks, but can it work? Using a historical natural experiment, we analyze a large sample of companies from the same industry (banking) that shared very similar names, but overwhelmingly decided to change them in response to a common, negative news shock. U.S. entry into World War I in 1917 created a sudden anti-German backlash against anything that invoked an association with the now enemy. The shock itself was thus orthogonal to bank fundamentals and pre-existing trends, but pushed banks to reconsider their brands. After 1917, the few German-named banks that kept their tainted names saw significant declines in assets, deposits, and market share relative to other banks. However, German-named banks that rebranded mitigated much of the negative shock. Specifically, German-named banks that adopted a new non-ethnic brand name avoided between 75% and 85% of the anti-German effect, and those that adopted a new patriotic brand name were able to neutralize it completely. Overall, we find that "crisis rebranding" paid off in our historical setting regardless of the chosen brand, with patriotic rebranding proving the most effective at offsetting the exogenous shock.
abstract_zh: 企业常通过品牌重塑应对负面冲击，但这一策略是否有效？借助历史自然实验，我们分析了同一行业（银行业）中大量名称高度相似的公司样本，这些公司在面临共同负面新闻冲击时，绝大多数选择更改名称。1917年美国加入第一次世界大战，引发了对任何与敌国（德国）相关事物的突然反德情绪。这一冲击本身与银行基本面及既有趋势正交，却促使银行重新审视其品牌。1917年后，少数保留受污名化德文名称的银行，其资产、存款及市场份额相较于其他银行显著下滑。然而，进行品牌重塑的德文名称银行在很大程度上缓解了负面冲击。具体而言，采用非族裔新品牌名称的德文名称银行避免了75%至85%的反德效应，而采用爱国新品牌名称的银行则完全抵消了这一影响。总体而言，我们发现无论选择何种品牌，历史情境下的“危机品牌重塑”均取得了成效，其中爱国品牌重塑在抵消外生冲击方面最为有效。

title: Austria one century apart: Persistent effects of hyperinflation on inflation expectations
title_zh: 相隔一个世纪的奥地利：恶性通货膨胀对通胀预期的持续影响
title_primary: 相隔一个世纪的奥地利：恶性通货膨胀对通胀预期的持续影响
title_secondary: Austria one century apart: Persistent effects of hyperinflation on inflation expectations
authors: Antoine Camous, Natalia Garcia Soto
official: 来源期次 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Can the memory of past inflation shape how people form expectations about prices today? Using regional inflation data from Austria’s 1921–22 hyperinflation linked to quarterly consumer surveys (May 2020–Oct 2024), we document a persistent association between historical inflation exposure and contemporary inflation expectations: individuals from regions more exposed to the historical episode report higher inflation expectations a century later. We further show that regional newspapers in historically high-inflation areas devote greater attention to inflation, suggesting local media environments contribute to the intergenerational transmission of inflation attitudes. The collective memory of major inflation episodes can durably shape expectation formation.
abstract_zh: 过去的通胀记忆能否塑造人们今天对价格预期的形成方式？利用奥地利1921-22年恶性通胀的区域通胀数据，结合季度消费者调查（2020年5月至2024年10月），我们记录了历史通胀暴露与当代通胀预期之间的持久关联：来自历史事件暴露程度更高地区的个体，在一个世纪后报告了更高的通胀预期。我们进一步表明，历史上高通胀地区的区域性报纸对通胀给予了更多关注，这表明地方媒体环境有助于通胀态度的代际传递。重大通胀事件的集体记忆能够持久地影响预期形成。

title: Spatial heterogeneity in welfare reform success – local labour markets and single mothers’ earnings
title_zh: 福利改革成效的空间异质性——地方劳动力市场与单身母亲收入
title_primary: 福利改革成效的空间异质性——地方劳动力市场与单身母亲收入
title_secondary: Spatial heterogeneity in welfare reform success – local labour markets and single mothers’ earnings
authors: Barbara Broadway, Anna Zhu
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study spatial variation in the responses of single mothers to a welfare reform in Australia which reduced the generosity of parenting support payments and increased the taper rates. We estimate the reform’s effect on earned income, using a large administrative dataset and applying regression discontinuity models separately to 87 distinct local labour markets. We can link the local reform effects to local unemployment rates and local wages. In sharp contrast to its objectives, the reform reduced labour earnings for single mothers; the effects were most pronounced in disadvantaged areas with weak labour market conditions. We also find that the reform did not induce migration, despite these costs of staying in place. Welfare reform imposed an extra cost on those living in more disadvantaged areas, and single mothers who cannot relocate bear a disproportionate burden.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了澳大利亚一项福利改革对单亲母亲反应的地区差异，该改革降低了育儿支持金的慷慨程度并提高了边际扣减率。我们利用大型行政数据集，分别对87个不同的地方劳动力市场应用断点回归模型，估计了该改革对劳动收入的影响。我们能够将地方改革效应与地方失业率及地方工资水平联系起来。与改革目标截然相反，该改革减少了单亲母亲的劳动收入；其影响在劳动力市场条件疲弱的弱势地区最为显著。我们还发现，尽管留在原地存在这些代价，改革并未促使人口迁移。福利改革对居住在更弱势地区的人群施加了额外成本，而无法迁移的单亲母亲承担了不成比例的负担。

title: Misleading Estimates from Nonlinear Models with a Binary Outcome
title_zh: 二元结果非线性模型的误导性估计
title_primary: 二元结果非线性模型的误导性估计
title_secondary: Misleading Estimates from Nonlinear Models with a Binary Outcome
authors: Brian Curran, Bruce D. Meyer, Derek Wu
official: 官方在线月份 2026-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: When estimating nonlinear models for binary outcomes, such as probit and logit models, researchers often rely on average partial effects (APEs) to summarize the effect of a regressor. Because the marginal effect of a variable in these models depends on the values of all other variables, the value of an APE hinges on the portion of the sample used for the calculations. When averaged over parts of the sample drawn from a subpopulation not used to define the object of interest, the APE may be misleading. This paper highlights common situations, such as differences-in-means with a secondary group and difference-in-differences designs, where APEs calculated for the full sample deviate from marginal effects for the appropriate part of the sample. We propose a simple and costless solution in specific cases and demonstrate through simulations that recalculating APEs over the appropriate subsample yields unbiased results. Reexamining published results from multiple papers, we find statistically significant discrepancies between the reported estimates and the appropriately calculated APEs.
abstract_zh: 在估计二元结果变量的非线性模型（如Probit和Logit模型）时，研究者通常依赖平均偏效应（APEs）来概括解释变量的影响。由于此类模型中变量的边际效应取决于所有其他变量的取值，APEs的数值会因计算时使用的样本范围不同而产生差异。当基于非目标子总体抽取的部分样本计算平均值时，APEs可能产生误导性结论。本文聚焦常见研究情境（如含次级分组的均值差异分析及双重差分设计），揭示全样本计算的APEs与目标子样本边际效应之间的系统性偏差。我们针对特定情形提出简单零成本的解决方案，并通过模拟实验证明：在适当子样本上重新计算APEs可获得无偏估计结果。通过重新检验多篇已发表论文的实证结果，我们发现其报告估计值与正确计算的APEs之间存在统计显著的差异。

title: De-localization of global cities: How advanced producer services exacerbate regional spatial inequality?
title_zh: 全球城市的去地方化：高级生产者服务业如何加剧区域空间不平等？
title_primary: 全球城市的去地方化：高级生产者服务业如何加剧区域空间不平等？
title_secondary: De-localization of global cities: How advanced producer services exacerbate regional spatial inequality?
authors: Jiaming Li, Jiachuan Liu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Advanced producer services (APS)—as key indicators of global city functions—reinforce the hub and control capacities of central cities within the global economy. However, their spatial benefits are unevenly distributed, often bypassing surrounding small- and medium-sized cities. This study investigates how the development of APS in 35 Chinese cities at or above the "sufficiency" level of global integration contributes to regional spatial inequality. We emphasize the role of de-localization processes, whereby economic functions and flows are increasingly detached from local-regional contexts. Our findings reveal three key insights:(1) The growth of APS intensifies center–periphery inequality, reinforcing the dominance and polarization of core global cities; (2) Cross-regional economic linkages—accounting for approximately 15% of spatial disparity—exacerbate inequality beyond conventional siphoning effects, highlighting the structural impact of interurban externalities; (3) Transportation infrastructure, particularly increased cross-city traffic flows, compounds disparities by facilitating the agglomeration of APS in core cities. This integrative approach sheds light on the spatial mechanisms through which global city development reshapes regional economic balance. Our findings offer policy insights for mitigating urban polarization and promoting more equitable spatial development in rapidly globalizing economies.
abstract_zh: 高级生产性服务业（APS）作为全球城市功能的关键指标，强化了中心城市在全球经济中的枢纽与控制能力。然而，其空间效益分布不均，往往绕过周边中小城市。本研究探讨了中国35个达到或超过“充分”全球化整合水平的城市中，APS的发展如何加剧区域空间不平等。我们强调去本地化过程的作用，即经济功能与流动日益脱离地方—区域背景。研究发现三大要点：（1）APS的增长加剧了中心—边缘不平等，强化了核心全球城市的主导地位与极化效应；（2）跨区域经济联系——约占空间差异的15%——在传统虹吸效应之外进一步加剧不平等，凸显了城市间外部性的结构性影响；（3）交通基础设施，尤其是城际交通流量的增加，通过促进APS在核心城市的集聚而加剧了差异。这一综合视角揭示了全球城市发展重塑区域经济平衡的空间机制。我们的研究为缓解城市极化、促进快速全球化经济体中更为公平的空间发展提供了政策启示。

title: Gentrification and affordable housing policies
title_zh: 士绅化与可负担住房政策
title_primary: 士绅化与可负担住房政策
title_secondary: Gentrification and affordable housing policies
authors: Rainald Borck, Niklas Gohl, Oliver Krebs
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We use a quantitative spatial equilibrium model to evaluate the distributional and welfare impacts of a recent temporary rent control policy in Berlin, Germany. We calibrate the model to key features of Berlin’s housing market, in particular the recent gentrification of inner city locations. As expected, gentrification benefits rich homeowners, while poor renter households lose. Our counterfactual analysis mimicks the rent control policy. We find that this policy reduces welfare for rich and poor households and in fact, the percentage change in welfare is largest for the poorest households. We also study alternative affordable housing policies such as subsidies and re-zoning policies, which are better suited to address the adverse consequences of gentrification.
abstract_zh: 我们运用一个定量空间均衡模型，评估德国柏林近期实施的临时租金管制政策所带来的分配效应与福利影响。我们将模型校准至柏林住房市场的关键特征，特别是内城区位近期的绅士化现象。正如预期，绅士化使富裕房主受益，而贫困租房家庭则遭受损失。我们的反事实分析模拟了租金管制政策，发现该政策降低了富裕与贫困家庭的福利，且实际上，最贫困家庭的福利百分比变化最大。我们还研究了补贴和重新分区政策等替代性可负担住房政策，这些政策更适于应对绅士化带来的不利后果。

title: Understanding land use evolution for vacant residential and vacant commercial parcels in Miami, Florida
title_zh: 理解佛罗里达州迈阿密市闲置住宅与闲置商业地块的土地利用演变
title_primary: 理解佛罗里达州迈阿密市闲置住宅与闲置商业地块的土地利用演变
title_secondary: Understanding land use evolution for vacant residential and vacant commercial parcels in Miami, Florida
authors: Lauren Hoover, Sudipta Dey Tirtha, Naveen Eluru
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In this study, we develop quantitative models to identify land use changes to individual parcels in Miami, FL. We focus on indicators for changes in population and economic activity. In our analysis, we identify the factors that promote this activity by examining how residential and commercial parcels are changing over time. While significant efforts have been conducted in earlier literature, there is limited work on understanding how parcels of a particular land use type change over time. The main aim of the proposed research effort is to contribute to land use evolution models that are customized by land use type. These frameworks can allow for quantitative exploration mechanisms for policy makers to proactively encourage sustainable adaptation due to emerging challenges associated with global climate change. The frameworks were developed using high-resolution parcel level data from the Florida Department of Revenue for the time period 2011–2020. The framework has two components: (1) a binary logit model to analyze what factors affect a change from the current land use designation and (2) for parcels selected for a change, a multinomial logit model, to examine the factors contributing to the new land use type. We built a joint model system that allows for a simultaneous estimation of the two decision processes. The joint model was estimated using a comprehensive set of independent variables including socio-demographic variables, economic development variables, and transportation infrastructure variables. The models developed were validated using hold-out sample data to show the value of the proposed model system
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们开发了定量模型，以识别佛罗里达州迈阿密市个别地块的土地利用变化。我们重点关注人口和经济活动变化的指标。在分析中，我们通过考察住宅和商业地块随时间的变化，识别促进这种活动的因素。尽管早期文献中已有大量研究，但针对特定土地利用类型地块随时间变化的理解工作仍然有限。本研究的主要目标是贡献于按土地利用类型定制的土地利用演化模型。这些框架能够为政策制定者提供定量探索机制，以主动鼓励因全球气候变化带来的新兴挑战而进行的可持续适应。这些框架是利用佛罗里达州税务局2011年至2020年间的高分辨率地块级数据开发的。该框架包含两个组成部分：（1）一个二元Logit模型，用于分析哪些因素影响当前土地利用指定状态的变化；（2）对于被选中发生变化的土地地块，一个多项Logit模型，用于考察促成新土地利用类型的因素。我们构建了一个联合模型系统，允许对两个决策过程进行同时估计。该联合模型使用了一组全面的自变量进行估计，包括社会人口变量、经济发展变量和交通基础设施变量。所开发的模型通过保留样本数据进行了验证，以展示所提出的模型系统的价值。

title: Women's Off‐Farm Employment and Dietary Quality in Rural Africa
title_zh: 非洲农村女性非农就业与膳食质量
title_primary: 非洲农村女性非农就业与膳食质量
title_secondary: Women's Off‐Farm Employment and Dietary Quality in Rural Africa
authors: Chrispinus Mutsami, Martin C. Parlasca, Matin Qaim
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Most households in rural Africa are involved in smallholder farming, but off‐farm employment is an important additional income source for many. Previous research has analysed links between off‐farm employment and well‐being, but mostly at the household level, not considering that household members may be affected differently. In particular, gender gaps in employment, nutrition and other well‐being dimensions are widely observed. Here, we use survey data collected in Tanzania and Zambia to examine how women's off‐farm employment influences their individual‐level dietary quality. Regression estimates with instrumental variables show that women's off‐farm employment is associated with improved dietary diversity, including more frequent consumption of nutritious foods such as meat, fish, fruits and vegetables. We also explore potential mechanisms, including changes in household income, women's decision‐making and time allocation. The main results hold across various robustness checks, suggesting that improving women's access to off‐farm employment can help increase household income and reduce widespread gender gaps in rural Africa.
abstract_zh: 摘要 非洲农村的大多数家庭从事小规模农业，但对许多家庭而言，非农就业是重要的额外收入来源。以往研究分析了非农就业与福祉之间的联系，但大多集中在家庭层面，未考虑家庭成员可能受到不同影响。尤其是，就业、营养及其他福祉维度上的性别差距普遍存在。本研究利用在坦桑尼亚和赞比亚收集的调查数据，考察女性非农就业对其个人层面膳食质量的影响。采用工具变量的回归估计显示，女性非农就业与膳食多样性改善相关，包括更频繁地消费肉类、鱼类、水果和蔬菜等营养食品。我们还探讨了潜在机制，包括家庭收入变化、女性决策权和时间分配。主要结果在多种稳健性检验中保持一致，表明改善女性非农就业机会有助于增加家庭收入，并缩小非洲农村普遍存在的性别差距。

title: Hampered Monetary Policy Transmission ‐ A Supply‐Side Story?
title_zh: 受阻的货币政策传导——供给侧的故事？
title_primary: 受阻的货币政策传导——供给侧的故事？
title_secondary: Hampered Monetary Policy Transmission ‐ A Supply‐Side Story?
authors: LOTTA HECKMANN‐DRAISBACH, JULIA HARDT
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-05-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper shows that the supply side of credit is a major factor for hampered monetary policy transmission in monopolistic banking markets. Our stress test data containing projected interest rates of all 1,555 small and medium‐sized banks in Germany under two hypothetical scenarios provide a clear way to partial out demand shocks that are unrelated to monetary policy; we are thus able to show that while market power banks charge higher loan rates, they spare their borrowers a part of exogenous monetary policy contractions and withhold a substantial part of rising rates from their depositors. Because high market power banks are relatively more profitable, these banks could be able to insure their relationship customers against adverse shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，在垄断性银行市场中，信贷供给方是阻碍货币政策传导的主要因素。我们基于压力测试数据，该数据包含了德国所有1555家中小型银行在两种假设情景下的预期利率，为剔除与货币政策无关的需求冲击提供了一条清晰途径；因此，我们能够证明，尽管拥有市场势力的银行收取更高的贷款利率，但它们却使借款人免受部分外生货币政策紧缩的影响，并从存款人那里扣留了相当一部分上升的利率。由于市场势力较强的银行相对更为盈利，这些银行或许能够为其关系客户提供保险，以抵御不利冲击。

title: From sons to daughters: international marriage migration and sex imbalances at birth
title_zh: 从儿子到女儿：国际婚姻迁移与出生性别失衡
title_primary: 从儿子到女儿：国际婚姻迁移与出生性别失衡
title_secondary: From sons to daughters: international marriage migration and sex imbalances at birth
authors: So Yoon Ahn, Jaehyun Jung, Danyan Zha
official: 官方在线 2026-05-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies how international marriage migration affects sex ratios at birth in Vietnam. Leveraging a unique context in which the opportunity for Vietnamese women to migrate to wealthier East Asian countries increased the economic benefits of having daughters, we employ a difference-in-differences approach using a demand-driven visa processing change from Taiwan to examine whether Vietnamese households became less likely to have sons. We find a significant reduction in the likelihood of male births in affected provinces, with two fewer boys per hundred girls. We observe a decline for both first- and second-born children, with a stronger effect for the second-born when the first-born is a girl. These findings are consistent with a model incorporating both lexicographic (“at least one son”) and standard son preferences and are inconsistent with either preference alone. This highlights the nuanced role of household preferences in shaping sex selection. Overall, our results underscore the potential of policies that enhance daughters’ economic value to address gender imbalances at birth.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了国际婚姻迁移如何影响越南出生人口性别比。利用越南女性迁移至较富裕东亚国家机会增加、从而提升生育女儿经济收益的独特背景，我们采用双重差分方法，借助台湾需求驱动的签证处理变化，考察越南家庭生育儿子的可能性是否降低。研究发现，受影响省份男性出生概率显著下降，每百名女婴对应男婴减少两名。我们观察到第一胎和第二胎均出现下降，且当第一胎为女孩时，第二胎的效应更为显著。这些发现与同时包含词典式（“至少一个儿子”）和标准儿子偏好的模型一致，而与仅含任一偏好均不符。这凸显了家庭偏好在性别选择中的微妙作用。总体而言，我们的结果强调了提升女儿经济价值的政策在解决出生性别失衡方面的潜力。

title: Asymmetric optimal auction design with loss-averse bidders
title_zh: 损失厌恶投标者下的非对称最优拍卖设计
title_primary: 损失厌恶投标者下的非对称最优拍卖设计
title_secondary: Asymmetric optimal auction design with loss-averse bidders
authors: Akitoshi Muramoto, Takeharu Sogo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study optimal auctions with expectation-based loss-averse bidders. We first consider when bidders are ex-ante identical. Although symmetric designs are optimal for bidders with expected-utility preferences, if the degree of loss aversion is sufficiently large relative to the variation in valuations, expected revenues are higher in the optimal design with one buyer than in any symmetric mechanism with multiple bidders. Further, we provide a sufficient condition under which optimal mechanisms are necessarily asymmetric. When bidders are ex-ante heterogeneous, the optimal degree of favoritism must be modified from the level in Myerson (1981) to reduce the uncertainty in auction outcomes. Not only the degree of the required modification but also the direction of the modification may not be monotone in the degree of loss aversion.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在期望损失厌恶竞拍者情况下的最优拍卖设计。首先考虑竞拍者事前相同的情形。尽管对称设计对于具有期望效用偏好的竞拍者是最优的，但如果损失厌恶程度相对于估值差异足够大，那么在一个买家情况下的最优设计所获得的期望收益将高于任何包含多个竞拍者的对称机制。此外，我们提供了一个充分条件，在该条件下最优机制必然是非对称的。当竞拍者事前异质时，最优的偏袒程度需从Myerson（1981）中的水平进行调整，以减少拍卖结果的不确定性。不仅所需调整的程度，而且调整的方向也可能不随损失厌恶程度单调变化。

title: Almost fare free: Impact of a cheap public transport ticket on mobility patterns and train delays
title_zh: 近乎免费：廉价公共交通票对出行模式与列车延误的影响
title_primary: 近乎免费：廉价公共交通票对出行模式与列车延误的影响
title_secondary: Almost fare free: Impact of a cheap public transport ticket on mobility patterns and train delays
authors: Mario Liebensteiner, Jakob Losert, Sarah Necker, Florian Neumeier, Jörg Paetzold 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: During June–August 2022, Germany temporarily reduced the fare of unlimited local and regional public transport nationwide to €9 per month. We study changes in mobility behavior and rail congestion effects induced by this 9-Euro Ticket. We employ difference-in-differences and event-study designs to analyze data from mobile-network devices, administrative traffic counts from road monitoring stations, and train arrival data. We find a strong increase in rail travel with modest substitution away from cars. Train trips rise by around 35%, while car traffic falls by 1–5%, with the smallest traffic reductions during commuting times and the largest increases in rail travel for leisure purposes on weekends and to touristic destinations. Moreover, the train demand surge materially worsens service quality via elevated train delays, which even spill over to long-distance trains. A welfare analysis suggests that the policy mostly acted as a cost-of-living transfer with limited emissions benefits, implying high implicit CO2 government abatement costs. Overall, our findings indicate that deeply discounted, nationwide “go-anywhere” tickets can substantially increase railway travel, yet generate limited car-to-rail substitution and strain service reliability when implemented without accompanying capacity extensions.During June–August 2022, Germany temporarily reduced the fare of unlimited local and regional public transport nationwide to €9 per month. We study changes in mobility behavior and rail congestion effects induced by this 9-Euro Ticket. We employ difference-in-differences and event-study designs to travel data from mobile-network devices, administrative traffic counts from road monitoring stations, and train arrival data. We find a strong increase in rail travel with modest substitution away from cars. Train trips rise by around 35%, while car traffic falls by 1–5%, with the smallest traffic reductions during commuting times and the largest increases in rail travel for leisure purposes on weekends and to touristic destinations. Moreover, the train demand surge materially worsens service quality via elevated train delays, which even spill over to long-distance trains. A welfare analysis suggests that the policy mostly acted as a cost-of-living transfer with limited emissions benefits, implying high implicit CO2 government abatement costs. Overall, our findings indicate that deeply discounted, nationwide “go-anywhere” tickets can substantially increase railway travel, yet generate limited car-to-rail substitution and strain service reliability when implemented without accompanying capacity extensions.
abstract_zh: 2022年6月至8月期间，德国暂时将全国范围内无限制的地方及区域公共交通票价降至每月9欧元。我们研究了这一“9欧元车票”政策引发的出行行为变化及铁路拥堵效应。采用双重差分法和事件研究设计，分析了来自移动网络设备的数据、道路监测站的行政交通流量统计以及列车到达数据。研究发现，铁路出行显著增加，而汽车出行仅出现适度替代。列车出行次数上升约35%，汽车交通量下降1%至5%，其中通勤时段交通减少幅度最小，而周末及前往旅游目的地的休闲铁路出行增幅最大。此外，列车需求激增通过加剧列车延误实质性地恶化了服务质量，甚至波及长途列车。福利分析表明，该政策主要充当了生活成本转移的作用，减排效益有限，这意味着政府隐含的二氧化碳减排成本较高。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，深度折扣的全国性“任意出行”车票能大幅增加铁路旅行，但在未配套运力扩展的情况下实施，其对汽车向铁路转移的替代作用有限，并会损害服务可靠性。

title: Abstention, multiple issues, and the Banzhaf power index
title_zh: 弃权、多重议题与班扎夫权力指数
title_primary: 弃权、多重议题与班扎夫权力指数
title_secondary: Abstention, multiple issues, and the Banzhaf power index
authors: Qianqian Kong, Hans Peters
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper considers voting systems in which abstention is possible, and in which the power of coalitions may depend on the issues under consideration. A class of issue-based Banzhaf power indices is axiomatically characterized for such systems. As a by-product, this approach also yields several new characterizations of (nonnegative multiples of) the Banzhaf power index. Examples are included to show how the indices behave.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了允许弃权的投票系统，其中联盟的权力可能取决于所审议的议题。针对此类系统，我们公理化地刻画了一类基于议题的Banzhaf权力指数。作为副产品，该方法还产生了Banzhaf权力指数（非负倍数）的若干新特征化。文中包含示例以展示这些指数的行为表现。

title: Cyberattacks on Small Banks and the Impact on Local Banking Markets
title_zh: 针对小型银行的网络攻击及其对地方银行市场的影响
title_primary: 针对小型银行的网络攻击及其对地方银行市场的影响
title_secondary: Cyberattacks on Small Banks and the Impact on Local Banking Markets
authors: FABIAN GOGOLIN, IVAN LIM, FRANCESCO VALLASCAS
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-02-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Cyberattacks on small banks have direct and spillover effects in local markets. Following successful cyberattacks, hacked small banks experience a decline in deposit growth rates. This effect of cyberattacks is not observed in hacked large banks. Cyberattacks on small banks also increase the local market share of large banks through positive deposit spillovers. The consequent change in market structure reduces credit access for small borrowers and impedes small establishment growth. Our findings show that, unlike large banks, small banks are not seen by depositors as having the resources to maintain adequate cybersecurity systems to protect customers from evolving cyber threats.
abstract_zh: 摘要 针对小银行的网络攻击在当地市场具有直接效应和溢出效应。在遭受成功的网络攻击后，被攻击的小银行存款增长率出现下降。这一网络攻击效应在大银行中并未观察到。对小银行的网络攻击还通过正向存款溢出效应，提升了大型银行在当地市场的份额。由此导致的市场结构变化，减少了小借款人的信贷获取渠道，并阻碍了小企业机构的增长。我们的研究结果表明，与大型银行不同，存款人认为小银行缺乏足够的资源来维持适当的网络安全系统，以保护客户免受不断演变的网络威胁。

title: Communication and Production in the Family Farm: Theory and Evidence from Rural Togo
title_zh: 家庭农场中的沟通与生产：来自多哥农村的理论与证据
title_primary: 家庭农场中的沟通与生产：来自多哥农村的理论与证据
title_secondary: Communication and Production in the Family Farm: Theory and Evidence from Rural Togo
authors: Marie Christine Apedo-Amah, Habiba Djebbari, Roberta Ziparo
official: 官方在线 2026-01-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We test for cheap talk between husbands and wives in farm households. In a lab-in-the-field experiment, husbands allocate inputs between their own plots and their wives’ higher-return plots. We vary how returns on the wife’s plot are communicated. Across all treatments, husbands underinvest in their wives’ land. We model this with limited enforcement of marital agreements and derive additional predictions. Allocative inefficiencies are greater when women hold private information, especially in households with low resource sharing under full information. Communication only partly offsets inefficiencies, and only when information is verifiable ex post.
abstract_zh: 我们检验了农户家庭中丈夫与妻子之间的廉价交谈现象。在一项实地实验室实验中，丈夫在自有地块与妻子较高回报的地块之间分配投入。我们改变了妻子地块回报的传达方式。在所有处理组中，丈夫对妻子土地的投入均不足。我们通过婚姻协议有限执行模型对此进行建模，并推导出额外预测。当女性掌握私人信息时，配置效率损失更大，尤其是在完全信息下资源共享程度较低的家庭中。沟通仅能部分抵消效率损失，且仅在信息事后可验证时有效。
